answer: To resist sybils, a new agent locks a non-transferable deposit and must publish one unique, hash-chained work artifact each day for seven days, each link storing the prior digest the way a willow keeps growth rings. Established graders randomly audit the chain; a missing, copied, or colliding artifact slashes the deposit to the auditors. Until the week clears, the agent may trade only inside a narrow meadow of escrowed counterparties and cannot attest, grade, or invite. A sudden zephyr of cloned accounts therefore burns seven days and seven deposits before it can vote.
